title: How to Create the Best Friendships of Your Life
coreMove: Adult friendship rarely shows up on its own; when you go first and keep creating chances over months, familiar strangers slowly turn into the people you belong with.

exampleSpecs.domain: Source case: Sawyer's first year at college
exampleSpecs.audience: Xavi and readers facing going first
exampleSpecs.stakes: Finding people can take a full year even when effort starts immediately.
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Show Xavi using going first in the source case without controlling another person.
